activation_rule: The no-control core runs first. Ablations are falsifiers only after a complete core pass; controls, neighbors, and ablations cannot rescue a failed core gate.

cost_protocol.base: common 5 bp fee plus 2.5 bp slippage per side
cost_protocol.doubled: organizer-owned rerun with ordinary costs multiplied by 2

mechanism_ablations.change: Use raw returns rather than same-bar median residuals.
mechanism_ablations.falsification_role: Tests whether the spread is merely common crypto direction.
Tests whether multi-horizon persistence adds beyond a short trend.
Tests whether the declared horizon consensus is necessary.

mechanism_ablations.change: Retain two-of-three sign requirement but remove agreeing-weight shrinkage.
mechanism_ablations.falsification_role: Tests whether disagreement magnitude carries information.
Tests whether excessive recent volatility degrades persistence.

mechanism_ablations.change: Set all three horizon weights to one third.
